keyPoints: The registry (registry.py) is generic — any app type in {ContainerApp, FunctionApp, APIM, StaticWebApp, ContainerAppJob, custom} can be added via POST /apps, not just the two originally hardcoded services
Container App Job health has no /health endpoint to poll — instead it checks the job's latest execution status via the ARM API and tails its console logs on failure
GET /discover uses OnBehalfOfCredential (discovery.py) so the Resource Graph query runs as the calling user, not the function's own Managed Identity — it can only see what that user can see
Managed Identity (for the function's own queries) holds Log Analytics Reader (scoped to the shared workspace) and Cost Management Reader (scoped to subscription)
No API keys in environment variables for the function's own Azure SDK auth — that flows through Managed Identity; GITHUB_TOKEN is the one exception, used for the optional GitHub integrations
Cost Management responses cached for 1h in memory; all other queries are live
GitHub Actions API requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var; gracefully degrades if unset; skips empty results when no token or runs are available; prefers push/dispatch/release events over scheduled runs
GitHub Pull Requests API requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var; gracefully degrades if unset; skips empty results when no token or open PRs are available
Parallel fan-out keeps response time under 3s even with 5+ downstream calls
CORS OPTIONS handler added to support browser preflight requests (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Allow-Headers: Authorization Content-Type)
ErrorRow objects include error_type and status fields, ensuring richer error context across health checks, metrics queries, and GitHub Actions logs
architecture.overview: Single HTTP-triggered function that executes all sub-queries in parallel via asyncio.gather and ThreadPoolExecutor, dispatching a different health-check strategy per registered app's type (HTTP ping, Function-App KQL, Container-App log query, or Container-App-Job ARM execution check). A separate GET /discover route runs an on-behalf-of Azure Resource Graph query so a signed-in user can find apps that haven't been registered yet. Uses a system-assigned Managed Identity for its own queries — no credentials stored in app settings. RBAC roles are assigned by the azure-infrastructure package.

sublines: Health: per-type dispatch — HTTP /health, Function-App KQL, Container-App logs, or Container-App-Job ARM execution status
Log Analytics KQL: request counts, latency, errors (24h)

GitHub Actions: latest workflow run status (optional per app)
GitHub Pull Requests: open PRs per app (optional per app)

description: Azure Functions app that is both a generic registry of every other app in the system and an aggregator over them: it health-checks, metrics-queries, and cost-queries whatever's registered, and can discover un-registered Azure resources on demand — returning everything in a single aggregated dashboard response.
features: App registry: GET/POST /apps, PATCH/DELETE /apps/{name} — CRUD over an Azure Table of registered apps, each typed as ContainerApp, FunctionApp, APIM, StaticWebApp, ContainerAppJob, or custom

Per-type health check dispatch: HTTP GET /health for Container/Function apps, a Log-Analytics KQL query (AppRequests/AppExceptions) for Function Apps, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL for Container Apps, and an ARM execution-status check (tailing console logs on failure) for Container App Jobs

GET /discover — on-behalf-of Azure Resource Graph query using the calling user's own token, to find un-registered Function Apps, Container Apps, Container App Jobs, APIM instances, and Static Web Apps
Log Analytics KQL queries for request counts, average latency, and errors per registered service (24h window)
Digits metrics from Table Storage (request volume, error rate) — a special-cased data source alongside the generic registry
Azure Cost Management MTD spend breakdown — cached 1h due to API rate limits

GitHub Actions API integration for latest workflow run status and failed jobs (optional per app); prefers push/dispatch/release events over scheduled runs; skips empty results when GITHUB_TOKEN is unset or API returns nothing
GitHub Pull Requests API integration for open PRs per app (optional per app); skips empty results when GITHUB_TOKEN is unset or API returns nothing
CORS OPTIONS handler added for preflight requests (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Allow-Headers: Authorization Content-Type)
ErrorRow objects include error_type and status fields for enhanced debugging and analytics
All data returned in a single response — frontend polls every 60 seconds
role: Aggregates health, metrics, and cost across all services
summary: Aggregator + registry for every other app in the system: a Table-Storage-backed registry (GET/POST /apps, PATCH/DELETE /apps/{name}) lets apps be added by type (ContainerApp, FunctionApp, APIM, StaticWebApp, ContainerAppJob, custom); a single dashboard endpoint fans out in parallel to health-check every registered app (per-type dispatch — HTTP /health, Log Analytics KQL for Function Apps, Container App console logs, or a Container App Job's latest execution status via ARM), query Digits' metrics table, and fetch Azure Cost Management MTD spend. An on-behalf-of GET /discover endpoint queries Azure Resource Graph with the calling user's own token to surface un-registered resources. Uses a system-assigned managed identity — no stored credentials.
